source.content: @isTest private class CurrentBaseLocalRuntimeRequiredDatabase002Test { @isTest static void missingDatabaseTwoContracts() { Database.Error error = new Database.Error(); error.message = 'bad'; error.statuscode = System.StatusCode.FIELD_CUSTOM_VALIDATION_EXCEPTION; System.assertEquals('bad', error.message); System.assertEquals('FIELD_CUSTOM_VALIDATION_EXCEPTION', String.valueOf(error.statuscode)); Object errorsType = (Database.Errors)null; System.assertEquals(null, errorsType); Database.GetDeletedResult deleted = new Database.GetDeletedResult(); deleted.deletedrecords = new List<Database.DeletedRecord>{new Database.DeletedRecord()}; deleted.earliestdateavailable = Date.today().addDays(-1); deleted.latestdatecovered = Date.today(); System.assertEquals(1, deleted.deletedrecords.size()); System.assertEquals(Date.today(), deleted.latestdatecovered); Database.GetUpdatedResult updated = new Database.GetUpdatedResult(); updated.ids = new List<Id>{'001000000000001AAA'}; updated.latestdatecovered = Date.today(); System.assertEquals(1, updated.ids.size()); System.assertEquals(Date.today(), updated.latestdatecovered); Database.LeadConvertResult leadResult = new Database.LeadConvertResult(); leadResult.accountid = '001000000000001AAA'; leadResult.contactid = '003000000000001AAA'; leadResult.leadid = '00Q000000000001AAA'; leadResult.opportunityid = '006000000000001AAA'; leadResult.relatedpersonaccountid = '001000000000002AAA'; leadResult.success = true; leadResult.errors = new List<Database.Error>(); System.assertEquals('001000000000001AAA', leadResult.accountid); System.assertEquals('003000000000001AAA', leadResult.contactid); System.assertEquals('00Q000000000001AAA', leadResult.leadid); System.assertEquals('006000000000001AAA', leadResult.opportunityid); System.assertEquals('001000000000002AAA', leadResult.relatedpersonaccountid); System.assertEquals(true, leadResult.success); System.assertEquals(0, leadResult.errors.size()); System.assert(leadResult.equals(leadResult)); System.assertEquals(leadResult.hashCode(), leadResult.hashCode()); System.assertNotEquals(null, leadResult.toString()); Database.LocaleOptions locale = new Database.LocaleOptions(); System.assertNotEquals(null, locale); Database.MergeRequest mergeRequest = new Database.MergeRequest(); System.assertNotEquals(null, mergeRequest); } }
